name: Logto
tagline: Open source Auth0 alternative. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, multi-tenancy, modern UI.
shortDescription: Logto is an open source identity platform. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, backup codes), social login, multi-tenancy, RBAC, beautiful UI, designed to be a drop-in Auth0 alternative.
longDescription:
## What it is

Logto is an open source identity platform. OIDC, OAuth2, MFA, social login, multi-tenancy, RBAC, organizations, audit logs, account center UI, sign-in experience UI, and a beautiful admin console.

## Why we recommend it

If you want a modern Auth0 alternative that you can self-host, Logto is the answer. The pre-built sign-in/account UIs save weeks of work, and the multi-tenant support is first-class.

## When to use it

- Auth0 alternative with self-hosting
- B2B SaaS with multi-tenant identity
- When you want pre-built sign-in UI (don't reinvent login)
- Modern apps that need OIDC + MFA
installInstructions:
**Docker Compose (recommended):**
```
git clone https://github.com/logto-io/logto
cd logto
docker compose up -d
```

**Cloud:** Logto Cloud - free tier (5K MAU), from $32/month.
pricingDetails: Self-host: free. Cloud: 5K MAU free. $32/month for production.
